content.text: The site's search URL is a page, so I'll use it.

input.command: S="--session task-alp"; for b in v3.19 v3.21; do agent-browser $S open "https://pkgs.alpinelinux.org/packages?name=curl&branch=$b&repo=main&arch=x86_64" >/dev/null; agent-browser $S eval '[...document.querySelectorAll("tbody tr")].map(r=>r.innerText.replace(/\s+/g," ")).join("\n")'; done
